arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Najera stated that California law allows post-conviction challenges to deadlines.
Mr. Gornstein argued the statute does not violate Ex Post Facto rules.
Ms. Gaard cited new evidence about delayed reporting of abuse.
Chief Justice Rehnquist noted the case was submitted.
